QA Engineer (AI Testing)
🔥
Зарплата: По договоренности
Компания: Innowise
Локация: Узбекистан, Польша, Грузия, Казахстан
О роли:
Поиск QA-специалиста с экспертизой в тестировании искусственного интеллекта и практическим опытом тестирования нейросетей, чат-ботов и LLM, понимающего специфику AI-решений наряду с традиционными методологиями тестирования.
Что ищут в кандидате:
• Практический опыт тестирования нейросетей, чат-ботов и LLM

• Понимание жизненного цикла разработки ПО (SDLC) и роли QA в нем

• Понимание принципов CI/CD, архитектуры информационных систем и виртуализации
• Знание сетевых протоколов (HTTP/HTTPS, TCP/IP)
Будет плюсом:
• Опыт руководства командой (Team Lead) на проекте или в рамках направления

jobs.salary_text: Discussed at the interview, based on skills and experience.
jobs.description:
Middle QA Engineer (Onsite, Tashkent)
About the Role
Join our team (React, NestJS, PostgreSQL) to ensure our web products are reliable and high quality: find bugs early and improve our release process.
Responsibilities
• Manual and automated testing of web applications
• Write and maintain test cases, test plans, and checklists
• Test REST APIs and verify data in the database
• Report, track, and verify bugs in detail
• Join requirement reviews and sprint planning
• Run regression testing before releases
Requirements
• 2+ years of commercial QA experience
• Strong testing theory: test design techniques, testing types/levels, bug life cycle, SDLC/STLC
• API testing (Postman, Swagger, or similar)
• Basic SQL for PostgreSQL data checks
• Test automation (Playwright, Cypress, or Selenium) in JS/TS
• Jira (or similar), Git, and browser DevTools
• English B2+
• Onsite work in Tashkent (no remote option)
Nice to Have
• Mobile testing (React Native, iOS/Android)
• CI/CD experience
• Performance/load testing
Interview Process
Technical, in two parts: (1) practical problem solving, such as writing test cases, finding bugs in a scenario, and logic tasks; (2) in-depth theory on testing, test design, API testing, SQL, and automation. We value candidates who understand why they test, not just how.
Salary: Discussed at the interview, based on skills and experience.
⚠️
Apply only if you have middle-level QA experience and match the requirements.
How to Apply
Send your CV and relevant links (GitHub with automation projects, portfolio) to
@iamrecruiting
with the subject “Middle QA Engineer”.
@unilance
- the best for you

jobs.title: Junior QA Tester / Junior Manual QA
jobs.description:
#qa
🧪
Junior QA Tester / Junior Manual QA
Kompaniya:
Free.uz
🏠
Ish sharoitlari: to'liq masofaviy. Nomzod O'zbekiston rezidenti bo'lishi kerak.
🕒
Bandlik turi: yarim stavka, kuniga taxminan 3–4 soat.
Maosh: 5,000,000 UZS
Biz boshlang'ich darajadagi sifat nazorati mutaxassisini qidiryapmiz.
Majburiyatlar:
- Veb-saytlarni sinovdan o'tkazish.
- Xatolarni aniqlash va ularning aniq tavsifini berish.
- Yangi funksiyalarning ishlashini tekshirish.
- Tekshiruv ro'yxatlari va test holatlarini yaratish.
Sizdan nimalarni kutamiz:
- QA tester sifatida 3–6 oylik tijorat tajribasi.
- So'nggi 3–6 oy ichida tegishli kurslarni tamomlagan yoki texnik yo'nalishda oliy ma'lumotga ega bo'lish.
- Diqqat-e'tibor eng muhim talabdir. Ishingizni qayta tekshirishga va natijalarni puxta tahlil qilgachgina topshirishga tayyor bo'lish.
- Muloqot ko'nikmalari. Agar nimadir noaniq bo'lsa, mustaqil ravishda yechim izlash va yechim topilmasa, savollarni aniq va qisqa qilib so'rash qobiliyati.
- Ingliz tilini bilish afzallik hisoblanadi.
Ta'lim va ish tajribasi haqidagi ma'lumotlar yetishmayotgan to'liq bo'lmagan rezyumelar darhol rad etiladi.
Arizalar uchun aloqa ma'lumotlari:
@mariya_freeuz
@unilance
- eng yaxshisi siz uchun
